weekend_race.race_comments: Layne Riggs has won the Team EJP 175 at New Hampshire Motor Speedway, his 11th victory in the NASCAR CRAFTSMAN Truck Series. Prior to the start of the race, the vehicle(s) dropped to the rear of the field under penalty: Nos. 26, 33 (driver change) and Nos. 76, 81 (unapproved adjustments).
